map.子宫内膜厚度与周期 使用指南: Endometrial Thickness and Cycle User Guide
map.按月经周期天数逐条记录子宫内膜厚度，自动分期（增殖期/分泌期）并给出对应阶段的临: Record endometrial thickness day by day across the menstrual cycle, auto-phase it (proliferative / secretory) and give clinical interpretation references for each phase — for preconception and menstrual health monitoring.
map.内膜厚度随周期：增殖期 4–12 mm、分泌期 10–14 mm；排卵前 ≥8: Endometrial thickness by cycle phase: proliferative 4–12 mm, secretory 10–14 mm; ≥8 mm before ovulation favours implantation
map.按周期日数划分增殖期/分泌期，以该期参考范围评估内膜偏薄/正常/偏厚。: Divide the proliferative and secretory phases by cycle day and use that phase's reference range to assess whether the endometrium is thin, normal or thick.
map.备孕女性按周期天数判断当前处于月经期/增殖期/排卵期/分泌期。: Women planning pregnancy judge by cycle day which phase they are in — menstrual / proliferative / ovulatory / secretory.
map.长期记录内膜厚度，观察排卵与着床窗。: Long-term record of endometrial thickness to observe ovulation and the implantation window.
map.辅助生殖中定位最佳移植窗口。: Locate the optimal transfer window in assisted reproduction.
map.：周期第 14 天判为排卵期（增殖晚期转排卵），内膜参考 8–12mm，适合备孕: : cycle day 14 is judged ovulatory (late proliferative turning to ovulation) with an endometrial reference of 8–12 mm, suitable for preconception timing.
map.：周期第 22 天为分泌期（黄体期），内膜参考 10–14mm；若记录显示该日厚: : cycle day 22 is the secretory (luteal) phase with an endometrial reference of 10–14 mm; if the record shows only 6 mm that day, a thin endometrium may impair implantation.
map.各期内膜厚度参考多少？: What is the reference endometrial thickness in each phase?
map.月经期 2–5mm、增殖早期 4–6mm、增殖晚期 8–12mm、分泌期 10–: Menstrual phase 2–5 mm, early proliferative 4–6 mm, late proliferative 8–12 mm, secretory 10–14 mm; ≥8 mm at ovulation is preferable.
map.周期不规律怎么判断阶段？: How to judge the phase when the cycle is irregular?
map.以超声监测排卵与内膜为准，单靠日历天数对周期不规律者误差大；可结合基础体温与 L: Use ultrasound monitoring of ovulation and the endometrium; calendar days alone give large errors for irregular cycles, so combine basal body temperature and the LH peak.
